accepted_threats.rationale: Per-session rate limiting deferred (D-05/D-06). Mitigated indirectly by LRU cache reducing upstream load.

Users editing local/settings.json is an intended operation (D-01). FS permissions + AppCert scope protect against unauthorized edits. Defense-in-depth: _validate_url IP-block still blocks private IPs even if a private IP is added to the allowlist.
os.utime() touch-on-read is best-effort. Concurrent reads racing on utime is benign (both set near-current time). No lock needed.

decisions.rationale: Per restmap.conf.spec, `script` is for handlers NOT derived from BaseRestHandler. Setting it forced runScript.py codepath which does os.chdir(dirname(script)) → FileNotFoundError('').

decisions.decision: build_release.sh strips macOS xattrs via bsdtar --no-mac-metadata --no-xattrs --no-acls --no-fflags
decisions.rationale: macOS 14+ com.apple.provenance xattr becomes a PaxHeader entry that Splunk's archive validator misreads as a second top-level directory.

decisions.decision: HTTP 403 vs 400 split for SSRF rejections
decisions.rationale: RFC 9110 §15.5.4: 400 for client-malformed, 403 for server-side policy refusal. _validate_url codes split: policy (host_not_allowed, invalid_ip, private_ip_blocked → 403) vs syntax (scheme_not_https, invalid_chars, dns_failed → 400). Encoded as _SSRF_POLICY_CODES set in handle_GET step 5.
